title: PM daily scratchpad - 2026-03-18
content:
Morning slice - quick notes (03/18)

Top priorities for today:
- Finalize PRD edits for Adaptive Batching v2 (target: land PRD by EOD). Need buy-in from infra + serving runtime on kernel selection tradeoffs.
- Follow up with SRE on canary rollout plan for Dedicated release (latency SLOs + alert thresholds).
- Launch checklist for small-batch experiment: make sure telemetry and cost-metering flags are in place.

PRD edits (things to resolve)
- TL;DR changes: add a fallback policy for older kernels if quantized path regresses >2% on eval set.
- Clarify SLA expectations for Dedicated customers vs hosted: add explicit fallback routing behavior (region -> cheaper model variant).
- Add rollout plan section: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> global; manual hold after each step; automatic rollback on error rate >1.5x baseline.
- Open questions:
  * Who owns the rollback automation? (SRE / infra?) --- talk to Priya.
  * Metrics: use p50/p95/p99 latency + cost per 1000 tokens + model correctness regression. Need metric owners.

Stakeholder follow-ups (action items)
- @Liam: confirm kernel compatibility matrix by EOD (RW-992).
- @Priya: draft canary playbook and alert runbook for Dedicated (include runbook steps, contact list).
- @Daniel: update telemetry dashboard with token-level cost breakdown for the small-batch experiment (include sampling config).
- Legal/Privacy: check KMS key rotation note for Private deployment docs (low priority, pinged legal last week).

Launch checklist (small-batch experiment / internal beta)
- Pre-launch:
  - [ ] PRD finalized and shared (link above)
  - [x] Internal alpha test with 3 customers completed (notes in RW-987)
  - [ ] Canary config prepared (traffic split, model variants)
  - [ ] Metrics dashboard template ready (Daniel)
  - [ ] Cost alarms configured (billing team)
- During canary:
  - [ ] Monitor p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, and cost per 1000 tokens
  - [ ] Verify KV cache hit rate and batching efficiency metrics
  - [ ] Weekly check-in w/ customer success for qualitative feedback
- Post-canary:
  - [ ] Write postmortem + performance notes
  - [ ] Update public docs / runbook

Meetings today:
- 09:30 - Sync with infra (kernel matrix, 30m) — agenda: compatibility gaps, quantization path risks.
- 11:00 - PRD review w/ stakeholders (45m) — PI: present fallback + rollout language.
- 15:00 - SRE ops walk-through (30m) — goal: finalize rollback owner and alert thresholds.

Random notes / scratch (messy):
- If we do fallback to cheaper model variant, need to ensure prompt templates survive (tokenization differences can change output length). Add note in PRD.
- Consider adding an explicit A/B vs canary experiment doc for quality monitoring (eval prompt set + automated regression alerts).
- Could leverage Redwood Optimize recommendations to pick quantization profile per customer workload; add as optional opt-in in PRD.
- Quick todo: update GH PR description for #428 with perf numbers and kernel compatibility table.

Blocking items (help needed):
- Kernel compatibility matrix (blocking PRD sign-off) — Liam
- Canary rollback automation owner (blocking rollout plan) — Priya

Short-term milestones:
- 03/18 EOD: PRD in review with infra + SRE comments captured.
- 03/20: Canary config and dashboard ready for internal beta.
- 03/27: Post-canary review + go/no-go for broader dedicated pool rollout.

Links / refs:
- Confluence: PRD-ADAPTIVE-BATCHING-V2 (linked)
- JIRA: RW-987 (small-batch experiment), RW-992 (kernel compatibility)
- GH PR: serving-runtime#428

Notes to self (if time):
- Draft a short customer-facing one-pager describing what small-batch experiment changes (benefits + rollback guarantees).
- Prep a short slide for Wednesday all-hands showing latency/cost delta from alpha test.

---
End of scratchpad for 03/18. Will tidy & move key items into PRD and tickets after meetings.
